scope: Purposive national historical case finding before 2026-05-09, prioritizing events before 2024. This is not an incidence census or a probability sample.
verification: TOI article text or publisher-indexed text returned by the web tool was checked for an officer-firearm-taking claim linked to subsequent police shooting. This subtask did not download raw HTML or validate article JSON-LD identity. Publication dates use TOI story-date banners; update timestamps remain separate. Police claims are not independently established facts. Final legal outcomes were not comprehensively researched.
units: One row per event, not per newspaper report, death, suspect, or weapon. A group claim is not an individual attribution to every person shot.

excluded_or_not_promoted.reason: Shares a report with Prabhat, but no immediate taking of an officer firearm is described for Bauwa; possession/recovery of guns is insufficient.
Retrieved reports described a checkpoint gunfight with an existing firearm, not an immediate police-firearm seizure. Not promoted merely because the event is called an encounter.
Retrieved follow-up describes a machete attack, not officer-firearm-taking. Distinct from Afruddin Islam in May 2022.

General recollection that police often invoked escape or gun-taking does not establish an individually dated and attributed gun-taking event. No new verified pre-2026 WB event added by this national search.

analysis_caution: Twelve selected historical leads do not supply a denominator, prevalence, trend, p-value or probability that any police account is true. Context, custody status, individual versus group attribution, and timing differ. Keep them separate from the frozen four-state 2024-2026 detected-case panel unless the comparison frame is extended consistently.
